parole.significato: lentils, lens (plant of the genus Lens, cultivated for their edible seeds; the seeds of these plants)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Old East Slavic ляца (ljaca, “lentils”), from Proto-Slavic *lęťa. Because of the roundish, flat seeds of this plant, K.
